;; Retain the specification and resolve its four operations.
(define clean-transition
  (network [] (list :sequence :cleanup-before :verify-unloaded :settle-memory)))

(define admit-model
  (network [] (list :sequence :check-budget :load-model :verify-configuration :preload)))

(define implement-and-assess
  (network [] (list :sequence :execute :evaluate)))

(define preserve-and-release
  (network [] (list :sequence :save-result :cleanup-after)))

(define reserve-for-128-gib (memory-reserve 137438953472))
